name: Hachigashuku Ruru
source: A local idol who does performances on the streets and at public stations. Originally she had 10 people with her, however due to various circumstances and problems everyone eventually left and Ruru was left alone. Though she is a hardworker, Ruru has trouble with choices and when faced with a problem that has two or more choices she will instantly hesitate. Recently she has been trying to promote herself by cosplaying different video game characters.
